items.title: 3M (MMM) Expands AI Data Center Optics Push With 500 Job Investment
items.summary: 3M (NYSE:MMM) and Amazon Web Services announced an expanded collaboration to scale 3M's Expanded Beam Optical platform for data centers. The partners aim to support next-generation optical connectivity for artificial intelligence focused data center infrastructure in the U.S. The initiative is expected to create over 500 jobs, including more than 100 new roles, and contribute nearly US$500 million to the economy. items.title: 3M Reaches $7.35B PFAS Personal Injury Settlement, Maintains 2026 Outlook
items.summary: 3M (NYSE:MMM) said it has reached a settlement to resolve personal injury claims in the aqueous film-forming foam, or AFFF, multidistrict litigation pending in federal court in South Carolina, marking what management described as a significant step in addressing its legacy PFAS-related litigation.
